_note: Every embodiment the export and evaluation code know about. Keys are the lowercase names stored in the data.
kind: human | robot. unidex_hand: folder under UniDex HandAdapter/urdf/{base,H2o}/ (robots only).
exclude_links: URDF link names that get no points (all points go to the remaining links). trained: whether the released checkpoints saw it. label: name shown in plots and tables (default: the key).
The first nine, in order, are the stored training data (EMBODIMENT_NAMES in scene_geometry.py; tests/test_embodiments.py checks this).
A variant of a stored hand has its own name, so its sampling seeds never collide with the stored hand's.

shadow_noforearm.label: shadow
shadow_noforearm._note: Shadow without its forearm mesh (~60% of Shadow's surface): the hand the checkpoint was trained on, minus the forearm points; plotted as 'shadow'
